title: SID SADP uncut
description:
Spacer-is-dielectric (SID) approach to self-aligned double patterning. The spacer (white) surrounding the red mandrels does not need to be cut or blocked, as it defines dielectric and assists the patterning of the blue fill features. Consequently, as shown here, a 45-50 nm pitch dense pattern (based on example from Kodama et al., 2015) is achievable by a single immersion lithography exposure. However, this pattern with a single inter-metal spacing over relatively long lengths is subject to greater parasitic capacitance risk.

Reference
C. Kodama et al., IEEE Trans. CAD Integ. Circ. and Sys., 34, 753 (2015).
US Patent Application 20150021782, assigned to Kabushiki Kaisha Toshiba.
